title: Layout rotation (l key) not working
description: Pressing `l` in normal mode should rotate the task list placement through left → top → right → bottom positions. The layoutPlacement signal updates but the UI doesn't reflect the change - the task list stays on the left side regardless of the setting.

title: Command palette overlay not rendering
description: When pressing Space or `:` to open the command palette, the mode changes to "command-palette" (visible in status bar) but the visual overlay component doesn't appear on screen. The CommandPalette component should render as an absolute-positioned overlay with a semi-transparent background, but it's not visible in the terminal output.

title: Task list selection highlight not visible
description: When navigating between tasks with j/k keys, the active task should be highlighted with a different background color (bg="#2a4a5a"). However, the highlight is not visibly rendering - all tasks appear the same regardless of which is selected. The activeTaskId signal updates correctly but the visual distinction doesn't appear.

title: Inefficient terminal size polling with setInterval
description: In tuirnr.tsx:178, there's a `setInterval` running every 100ms to check if the scrollbox size has changed and resize PTYs accordingly. The comment notes "OpenTUI doesn't have per-element resize events exposed to JSX easily". This polling approach is inefficient and could cause performance issues. Should investigate if OpenTUI has resize callbacks or use a more efficient detection method.

title: Status icons inconsistency - getStatusIcon() not used
description: There's a `getStatusIcon()` helper function in task-types.ts that defines status icons (● running, ⏸ stopped, ✗ crashed, ↻ starting, ○ idle), but tuirnr.tsx defines its own inline getStatusIcon function with different icons (▶ running, ■ stopped, ⏵ starting, ○ default). The helper function should be used for consistency.

title: Remove debug code left in production
description:
Debug code remains in the codebase:

1. tuirnr.tsx:377-381 - `x` key handler with comment "DEBUG: Toggle zoom on any unhandled key to verify handler is being called"
2. task-manager.ts - DEBUG_ENABLED flag and debugLog function (currently disabled but still present)
3. tuirnr.tsx:51 - renderCount signal used for debugging

This debug code should be removed before production use.

title: Duplicate task list rendering logic with inconsistent patterns
description: The task list is rendered in two separate `<Show>` blocks (lines 626-667 for left/top placement, lines 699-735 for right/bottom placement). The first uses `<For each={tasks()}>` while the second uses `{tasks().map()}`. This inconsistency could cause subtle reactivity differences in Solid.js. Should consolidate into a single component or ensure consistent patterns.

title: Status view toggle (S key) not working
description: Pressing `S` should toggle between output view (showing terminal output) and status view (showing task details like PID, exit code, timestamps). The showStatusView signal toggles but the output panel content doesn't change - it continues showing terminal output instead of switching to the status text.
